title: polypogon fugax f. demissus
intro: Polypogon fugax f. demissus, commonly known as Common Hairgrass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Polypogon fugax f. demissus include its ability to reduce swelling and promote tissue repair, as well as its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
